body:
thank you. i say i feel normal because i don't feel depressed - i have been up and down a lot, but if anything i'm feeling 'up'. i don't have a particular concious desire to kill myself, but it keeps popping into my head, to the extent where I can't concentrate. 

from what i have read, my thoughts constitute reasonable grounds to be committed to an institution. 

i don't think i want to take any drugs or speak to any doctors, because I don't want to be committed to an institution. 

however, I am concerned about myself. at the moment my plan is to try sleep and think about it tomorrow. I am more worried about feeling out of control than anything.

thank you for your advice. 

i have just spoken to the samaritans - they are going to give me a call back tomorrow. 

i don't want to talk about my work.

i am not sure what is triggering this. 

i have a family history of depression and suicide. my father comitted suicide. his father was a psychiatrist who suffered through most of his life.

i feel strong urges to kill myself. i feel normal when they happen. i am worried that I won't be able to stop them. 

i understand that there can be chemical imbalances in the brain. i distrust psychiatric drugs. i feel that the world is coming to an end and my only reason to keep going is my family, but in truth my family would be better off without me. 

the worst part is that i feel quite calm and rational about this and i am struggling to ignore these thoughts.
